messages:
Maya (CS): just finished a 30m with NovaHealth — they sent a bulk dump of feedback and a short wishlist. main themes: per-route cost visibility, onboarding friction for token limits, and a 'save default prompt' request.
Akash (Eng): can you attach the CSV? we can run quick aggregation to heatmap counts.
Maya (CS): pasted the top lines from their export:
```
customer_id,feature_area,priority,user_quote,context
NovaHealth,Cost Attribution,high,"I can't tell which routes are burning budget",onboarding
NovaHealth,Onboarding,high,"New users get rate-limited during initial sync",first-week
NovaHealth,UX,medium,"Would love saved prompt templates per workspace",workflow
```
Priya (CS): thanks — this aligns with 3 other pilots. renewing in 9w, flagging as a potential churn risk if we don't show per-route numbers.
Sam (Product): per-route cost is already on the backlog but no ETA. we could ship a lightweight `cost-by-route` dashboard as a Q2 quickwin. need an example query and expected metrics.
Jess (UX): quick question — for "save default prompt" do they want team-level templates or user-level? that changes design.
Maya (CS): they want team-level templates + an org default. they said "we need presets for call summaries across teams".
Akash (Eng): for heatmap, I'll run `groupby(feature_area).count()` on the CSV and share a gist.
FeedbackBot: automated note: new feedback batch uploaded to /feedback-repo/novahealth/2281234567.csv :eyes:
Priya (CS): can we triage into lanes: quick-win (<=2w), medium (1-2 sprints), roadmap (Q3+)? I'll label each item in the ticket.
Sam (Product): yes — I'll own priority rubric. quick-wins candidate: saved prompt templates (low infra), tooltip + docs for token limits (very low). roadmap: per-route cost (higher infra + product), onboarding autoscaling (ops work).
Akash (Eng): rough effort: saved templates ~2 dev days + small migrations; per-route cost dashboard ~3 wks (metrics + ingestion); onboarding autoscale depends on infra but maybe 2-3 sprints.
Maya (CS): renewal note: asked for proof-of-progress. Priya — can you draft a short 1-pager to share? include proposed timeline and mitigations.
Priya (CS): will do. also scheduling a sync with their engineering lead next Tue.
Jess (UX): I'll prototype the templates UX in Figma and share a quick link by EOD Fri.
Sam (Product): action items: 1) Akash run aggregation and post heatmap gist 2) Jess prototype templates 3) Priya draft renewal 1-pager + schedule 4) Sam will create a `novahealth` feature board and add labels `cs-priority` / `quick-win`.
Maya (CS): tagging @Sam @Akash @Jess — please reply with ETA in thread. NovaHealth is politically sensitive; their success influences a potential reference. :warning:
Akash (Eng): ETA heatmap gist by tomorrow noon.
Jess (UX): prototype by Friday EOD.
Sam (Product): board + initial labels live within 1 day.
Priya (CS): 1-pager draft by Monday morning.
Maya (CS): thanks team. I'll attach the raw CSV and call notes to the new board entry and ping their CSM after we have the high-level plan. :rocket:
Akash (Eng): one more ask — if we add per-route tagging we'll need guidance on the schema. Maya can you confirm the route identifiers they use (e.g., `route_id` vs `route_name`)?
Maya (CS): they use `route_name` in their export. I'll confirm exact naming in the sync.
Sam (Product): perfect. once we have that I'll drop an initial spec and open a spike ticket for infra.
FeedbackBot: reminder scheduled: follow-up sync with NovaHealth on 2281235200.
Priya (CS): marking thread with :star: — will update product board after sync.
Maya (CS): noted — moving this to `cs-priority` and closing the loop here. thanks everyone.
